description: This file defines the internal class InsideRuntimeClient which implements IRuntimeClient and ILifecycleParticipant, providing core runtime functionalities for Orleans system grains such as message sending, invocation, response handling, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: InsideRuntimeClient
classes.description: A core internal class managing message passing, invocation, response processing, and lifecycle activities for Orleans system grains within a silo.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends a message request to a target grain, registering callbacks if necessary.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message back to the requester, with error handling.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming response messages, including handling rejections, status updates, and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current response timeout setting.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates an object reference for a remote addressable object.

methods.name: BreakOutstandingMessagesToSilo
methods.description: Marks all outstanding messages to a dead silo as failed.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the client to the silo lifecycle for start/stop activities.
